title: swing44: out-of-sample replication of swing43 (RSI(2) pullback in a long-term uptrend, held for days) on 6 equity indices that were not in swing43
before_registration: Ran: fetch.py (12 candidates), swing43 fixtures plus swing44 universe fixtures (swing44.py check), and swing44.py describe (history start/end, daily return correlation with the 8 swing43 indices, trade counts; entry and exit bars only, no return, drift or excess computed). Prior knowledge: swing43 FAIL on the dev CI only (indices excess +16.9 bps [-6.0,+36.4] dev, +33.7 [+6.7,+59.8] 2023+; down3 and RSI<5 stronger, unregistered).
data: audit/swing44/daily.db (new file, fetch.py: same FXEmpire proxy, URL, headers and 3 s throttle as audit/tsmom36/fetch.py; daily mid, bars close 17:00 New York; read through ext39.load(), weekend stubs dropped, last close 2026-10-08). Candidates FR40_EUR, EU50_EUR, NL25_EUR, CH20_CHF, ESPIX_EUR, SG30_SGD, CN50_USD, IN50_USD, TWIX_USD, US2000_USD, CHINAH_HKD, JP225Y_JPY: all served. swing43 indices from audit/tsmom36/daily.db read-only (correlation and the not-independent pooled view only). Spreads: audit/tsmom36/out/spreads.json (history.db M1 medians; only EU50_EUR present, 2.82 bps), ext39 2 bps per side fallback for the other five.
universe_rule: keep a candidate if its first close is on or before 2010-12-31 AND its maximum daily simple-return correlation (common dates from 2005) with any swing43 index is <= 0.95. Kept: FR40_EUR (max corr 0.921 with DE30), EU50_EUR (0.934 DE30), NL25_EUR (0.823 DE30, starts 2008-01-21), CH20_CHF (0.691 DE30), SG30_SGD (0.496 HK33), US2000_USD (0.895 SPX500). Dropped for history after 2010: ESPIX (2016-12), CN50 (2011-08), IN50 (2011-08, ends 2022-07), TWIX (2011-08, ends 2023-10), CHINAH (2020-11, corr 0.966 HK33), JP225Y (2020-04, corr 0.999 JP225: also a near copy). Caveat: FR40 and EU50 are 0.92-0.93 correlated with DE30 and all trades share calendar weeks with swing43 trades, so the replication is independent in instruments, not in market episodes.
rule: swing43.py imported unchanged (sha256 pinned in code): setup close > SMA200 and Wilder RSI(2) < 10 at the 17:00 NY close, long at that close, exit first close > SMA5 or 10 trading bars, one open trade per instrument, trades without an exit bar dropped. Statistic: excess = ln(exit/entry) - mu_w x bars held, mu_w = mean daily log return on days with prior close > SMA200 in the trade's window (dev 2005-22 or 2023+), exactly as swing43.build. Costs (reported only): futures-style = gross - 2 x half median spread; CFD = futures-style - 0.822 bps per calendar night.

primary.universe: 6 new indices pooled, equal weight per trade
primary.window: full 2005-01-01..2026-10-08 by entry date (dev and 2023+ trades together, each with its own window drift as in swing43)
primary.ci: swing43.ci = ext39.week_boot, ISO week of entry date, 1000 reps, seed 44, percentile 95%
primary.pass: full-period pooled excess > 0 with CI lower bound > 0, AND point estimate of pooled excess > 0 in 2005-2022 AND in 2023+. Otherwise FAIL. One test
primary.power_ex_ante: swing43 realised MDE80 30 bps for 1,043 dev index trades; with 902 trades MDE80 about 30-33 bps. The swing43 point estimates (+17 dev, +34 2023+) sit at or below this, so a true effect of swing43 size has well under 80% power; a FAIL is weak evidence against a small effect

secondary_never_decide: 3 consecutive down closes (swing43 variant down3) and RSI(2) < 5 (rsi5), first clean test since they were not registered in swing43: full, dev, 2023+
